rationale: A break of the half-hour opening range on above-normal volume follows through when an 08:30 economic release has already set the morning's direction and chops back into the range on quiet no-news mornings, so the main setting is the day set: every day, any-release day, or 08:30-release day. Losing side: Traders who fade the first volume-backed break of the opening range on a release day and are stopped as the news direction carries.

filter.plain: only when the bar that just closed has more volume than the median of the same clock bar over the 14 days before
